criteria.requirement: Add sessionize(iterable,key,gap) yielding ordered lists of original events. Start a new session only when consecutive event gap is STRICTLY greater than nonnegative numeric/timedelta gap, preserving identity and source order; equality stays in session. Support one-shot/empty/duplicate/cross-day inputs, reject observed reverse timestamps and negative gap, propagate incompatible key/arithmetic errors. Use no real clock and keep only current session plus lookahead, with documented full-session memory.
